name: Enlil: Rise Of the End
detailed_description:
Enlil: Rise Of the End is an action‑adventure epic set in a sprawling open world powered by stunning 3D HDRP graphics. Build your own defenses—walls, gates, and traps—collect valuable resources and choose mastery of five distinct magical disciplines. Defend your city, lead epic sieges against enemy towns and kingdoms, and overthrow the dark reign of Anzu!

Game Mechanics

  • Realistic 3D HDRP Environments: Lifelike lighting, detailed textures, and dynamic weather.

  • Construction System: Erect walls, doors, and traps to fortify your stronghold.

  • Resource Gathering: Scavenge rare materials, magic stones, and equipment across the open world.

  • Five Magic Disciplines: Wield Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth, or Spirit spells.

  • Open‑World Sieges: Defend your city and launch offensives on neighboring settlements.

  • Customizable Controls: Tailor input schemes to your play style.

  • Territory Domination: Purge regions of evil to claim ownership on the world map.

  • Day‑Night Cycle: Adapt to changing threats and opportunities as time flows.

  • Flexible Combat System: Adjustable melee and ranged attack mechanics for varied play.

  • Character Progression: Level up skills and boost stats by equipping powerful items.

  • Enemy Encampments: Clear out bandit forts and dark cult strongholds.

  • Economy Management: Assign workers in conquered cities to generate resources and currency, while balancing upkeep costs.

  • Diverse Foes & Creatures: Battle human adversaries, wild beasts, malevolent gods, and monstrous abominations.

  • Third‑Person Perspective: Full camera freedom with zoom in/out controls.

  • Immersive Music & Ambience: Original score and environmental soundscapes.

  • Creative Freedom: Shape the world and narrative through your choices.

Story

The Anunnaki gods forge Anzu to safeguard the cosmic balance by guarding the fabled Tablet of Destinies. Betrayed by ambition, Anzu steals the tablet and plunges half the world into a cataclysmic darkness. As kingdoms fall and hope fades, the son of Adab’s Ugula rises from the ashes. Reborn by Ninurta’s divine intervention, he must reclaim the three shards of the Shar‑ĝalazu sword and unravel the tablet’s mysteries. A final confrontation in Girsu’s caverns will decide the fate of gods and mortals alike…

Embrace Eternity, Forge Your Legend
Rise from the ashes of Adab, challenge the gods, and ignite a new dawn of civilization. In Enlil: Rise Of the End, the saga transcends mortality.

short_description: In a stunning open world brimming with high-quality graphics, build your own walls, gates, and traps; gather valuable loot; choose one of five mighty spells to obliterate your foes; command your army—and in a deep, immersive narrative, bring an end to Anzu’s dark reign!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11, 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 / AMD Ryzen 5 2400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 580
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1080p Resolution
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11, 10
  • Processor: Quad core 4Ghz+ from 2020 or newer
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 capable GPU with 4 GB VRAM - GeForce GTX 1050 Ti, Radeon RX 570, Intel Arc
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: High resolution, High quality compression

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains medium-intensity bloody knife fight scenes. There is no sexual content; slang language is minimal. Violence scenes are realistic but not extreme. Sensitive gamers are advised to seek prior information.
